column6: All timing data assumes two-clock reads and writes. B = Base Address; 0, An, PC, Xn, An+Xn, PC+Xn. Form does not affect timing. I = Index; 0, Xn. % = Total head for fetch immediate effective address timing includes the head time for the operation. NOTE: Xn cannot be in B and I at the same time. Scaling and size of Xn do not affect timing.
